title: Licochalcone B inhibits oxidative stress and ferroptosis in diabetic nephropathy through regulating ATF3/SLC7A11/GPX4 axis.
authors: Sun, Jiaxin; Huang, Sihui; Jing, Yingyu; Chen, Minchun; Zhang, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甘草查尔酮B通过ATF3/SLC7A11/GPX4轴抑制糖尿病肾病氧化应激和铁死亡，虽涉及ATF3蛋白与配体的分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Diabetic nephropathy (DN) is one of the most serious and common diabetes-associated complications. Licochalcone B is a chalcone that has been found to possess anti-diabetic activity. However, protective potential of licochalcone B in DN remains unclear. In this study, we investigated the protective effect of licochalcone B against DN both in vitro and in vivo. The results showed that licochalcone B protected HK-2 cells from high glucose (HG)-induced oxidative stress and ferroptosis. Further molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation revealed the stable binding abilities of licochalcone B and activating transcription factor 3 (ATF3). We found that licochalcone B negatively regulated ATF3 expression. Licochalcone B also inhibited the HG-induced ATF3 expression in HK-2 cells. ATF3 overexpression reversed the inhibitory effects of licochalcone B on oxidative stress and ferroptosis in HG-induced HK-2 cells. Moreover, ATF3 overexpression downregulated the expression levels of solute carrier family 7 member 11 (SLC7A11) and glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4), which are two critical regulators of ferroptosis. In vivo assays also proved that licochalcone B administration significantly improved histopathological changes in kidney tissues from HFD/STZ mice. Overall, our findings suggested that licochalcone B exerted protective effect against DN through ameliorating oxidative stress and ferroptosis via regulating ATF3/SLC7A11/GPX4 axis. These results highlighted the therapeutic potential of licochalcone B in preventing and treating DN. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at 10.1007/s10616-026-00910-2.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病肾病（DN）是糖尿病最严重且常见的并发症之一。甘草查尔酮B是一种查尔酮，已被发现具有抗糖尿病活性。然而，甘草查尔酮B在DN中的保护潜力尚不清楚。在本研究中，我们通过体外和体内实验探讨了甘草查尔酮B对DN的保护作用。结果表明，甘草查尔酮B保护HK-2细胞免受高糖（HG）诱导的氧化应激和铁死亡。进一步的分子对接和分子动力学模拟揭示了甘草查尔酮B与激活转录因子3（ATF3）之间的稳定结合能力。我们发现甘草查尔酮B负向调控ATF3表达。甘草查尔酮B还抑制了HG诱导的HK-2细胞中ATF3的表达。ATF3过表达逆转了甘草查尔酮B对HG诱导的HK-2细胞中氧化应激和铁死亡的抑制作用。此外，ATF3过表达下调了溶质载体家族7成员11（SLC7A11）和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）的表达水平，这两者是铁死亡的关键调控因子。体内实验也证明，甘草查尔酮B给药显著改善了HFD/STZ小鼠肾组织的病理学变化。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，甘草查尔酮B通过调控ATF3/SLC7A11/GPX4轴改善氧化应激和铁死亡，从而发挥对DN的保护作用。这些结果凸显了甘草查尔酮B在预防和治疗DN中的治疗潜力。补充信息：在线版本包含补充材料，可在10.1007/s10616-026-00910-2获取。
